dropped.reason: NONDETERMINISTIC BINARY BUG, source-diagnosed (all 8 modes share specarpe): ap_hilite.c:820 mallocs the per-channel ARPE_KEEP sustain array WITHOUT initialisation and hilite.c:492/506 read it to choose sustain-vs-new-note from the first window - per-process heap garbage steers the render. Empirical: four identical invocations -> four distinct data chunks; SAME-SECOND pair differs (not clock seeding; no rand in dev/hilite at all); rate 0.25 (wavetable never wraps) still differs; resyntheses of identical argv swing from pure silence (-240 dBFS) to full-scale clipping (0 dBFS). Second latent OOB: hilite.c:1191 fmod(pos,1024) + hilite.c:452 round(pos) can index ARPE_TAB[1024], one past the 1024-double table (ap_hilite.c:780). Ranges recorded pre-drop: wave 1-4, rate 0-344.53 (= window rate), -p 0-1; all nine flags live; rate brk accepted. Reachable via execute() at user's risk; afta8's amplitude-overflow warning corroborates.
